title: Portuguese Noodle Bowl
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make noodle dish inspired by Portuguese cuisine. Serve immediately and enjoy!
instructions: Cook vermicelli noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine cooked rice, Portuguese seasoning blend, salt, and black pepper. Mix well.
Add cooked vermicelli noodles to the bowl and toss to combine.
In a small pan, heat lightly oiled over medium heat.
Add sliced almonds to the pan and toast until lightly browned, stirring frequently.
Remove almonds from heat and sprinkle over the noodle mixture.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
